_about: Build 2026-11-23a (test 59's fixes and the tester's wishes, on top of 2026-11-22a: getting off parks the bike beside you in one ask of the plugin, the spot back along the track the fallback ([Room] ParkBeside); its lean on its side stand from upright held to 5..20 degrees, a tyre's ray that met a car's body looked under and each wheel on the highest of its footprint ([Room] ParkLean, ParkTyres); getting on hides the parked bike under the fade before the worn bike's equip and stands it up by its own script ([Room] MountHide); the Wear and Paint condition on every bike at every equip and load, the parked bike's runtime swap on by default and at a getting off too, the worn bike's kept through a getting on, 0.1 s after its equip, retried and confirmed, the composed swap reused ([Look] OverlayParked, OverlayEvery, OverlayQuick); the field kit's new bike posed before it is drawn, no frame of the menu's own pose between options ([Look] KitLate, KitPrePlace); the third-person look with a weapon drawn, the game's own swing of its camera told from the plugin's, no check switching anything off for the session ([View] LookOrbitGame, LookRecover); a pistol drawn while riding held one-handed, the left hand on its grip, in third person by the plugin's hold and in first person with your body shown ([Tilt] GunOneHand, GunHoldAt, [View] BodyGunGrip); a holster mod's copies on the thigh found as attachments of the thigh's bone ([Tilt] AttachSkeleton, [Diag] AttachFresh); no item-use clip in third person while riding ([Steer] UseNoClip); a quicker take-off ([Steer] LaunchFrom 0.25, [Sound] HeardRiseGears 2.1,1.35,1,1,1); Rusty and Raider's rust lighter, see-through with dark edges and nothing along a badge plate's outline; three meshing gears either side of the 3D Brotherhood helmet), packaged on 2026-11-10a's package as the asset base with fifteen overlays laid over it in this order (OVERLAY=<1>:<2>:...:<15>, the later winning): 2026-11-22a's thirteen, unchanged (/opt/cmb/assets15b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/a/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/c/Data, /opt/cmb/assets17a/badges/Data, /opt/cmb/assets17a/plates/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/shells/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/wear/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/art2d/Data, /opt/cmb/assets22a/shells/Data, /opt/cmb/assets22a/wear/Data, /opt/cmb/assets22a/art2d/Data, /opt/cmb/assets22a/parked/Data), then the wear unit's (/opt/cmb/assets23a/wear/Data: the whole 243-file tree by look_wear.py --rust 2026-11-23a, 213 of its files 2026-11-22a's bytes, Rusty's and Raider's 30 maps redrawn; it replaces 2026-11-22a's wear overlay's files of those names) and the art2d unit's (/opt/cmb/assets23a/art2d/Data: badges_d/_n/_s.dds by bike_art.py --badges --bos-ground 2026-11-23a and look_badges.py, replacing 2026-11-22a's art2d's three). The two new overlays share no file, and each overlay's SHA256SUMS matches its files. Keys starting with _ are comments. What differs from the 2026-11-22a package, in two kinds: (1) the commit's own shipped files, checked against the commit by the tracked-files check and never listed in vs_previous (verify_zips.py --list-changes compares only the assets and the compiled scripts): Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.ini, Data/Scripts/Source/User/CMB_ControllerScript.psc, CMB_LookF4SE.psc and CMB_BikeActivatorScript.psc, and Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.dll once the build's DLL is committed (the package takes the DLL from the commit, so tools/f4se-slope/build.sh's DLL has to be committed first; git diff --stat 131f6b4 <the build's commit> -- Data lists them); the ESP and the MCM folder are 2026-11-22a's byte for byte; (2) the compiled scripts and assets, below (vs_previous): 33 textures changed, none added, and three compiled scripts.
_previous: The 2026-11-22a package: the verifier's --previous (/opt/cmb/out/2026-11-22a/CommonwealthMotorbike_2026-11-22a). The asset base is 2026-11-10a's Data (assets.sha256), with 2026-11-22a's thirteen overlays and this build's two.

esp._records: The ESP is 2026-11-22a's byte for byte (git diff 131f6b4 <the build's commit> -- Data/CommonwealthMotorbike.esp Data/MCM tools/esp-generator is empty): the header's 1337 records and next ID 0xD1B, as 2026-11-22a's; espcmp.py 2026-11-22a's ESP against this one: 'TES4: same', 'added 0', 'removed 0', 'changed 0'. The new behaviours need no form: the look's two new switches are bits of the existing CMB_LookOptions (2097152 OverlayEvery, 4194304 OverlayQuick; OverlayParked's 1048576 now set by default), the parked bike's three are bits of CMB_RoomOptions (65536 ParkBeside, 131072 ParkLean, 262144 MountHide) with a new ask kind (7) of CMB_RoomAskKind, and the scripts' new values are AutoReadOnly properties (no ESP property).
esp._edids: No record is new or changed: 2026-11-22a's list, as it was (its 52 new forms first, then 2026-11-21a's list). An older plugin has the same names; the bytes are held by the tracked-files check (the package's ESP is the commit's, byte for byte).

_counts: 2026-11-22a's: no file added or removed (the 33 textures are replaced in place, the same sizes). Textures/CMB/Bike holds 277 DDS, 165.3 MB, as before.
_vs_previous: What verify_zips.py --list-changes compares: the assets (the files under Data/Meshes/CMB, Textures/CMB, Materials/CMB, Sound/FX/CMB and the riding clips' folder) and the compiled scripts (Data/Scripts/*.pex, by their code, not their headers) against the 2026-11-22a package. 33 textures differ, each the same size as 2026-11-22a's, with its sha256 in this package (the overlays' SHA256SUMS; computed from the overlays against the 2026-11-22a package's folder): Rusty's and Raider's 30 Wear maps (wear_rusty_<shape> and wear_raider_<shape>, shape static, fork, static_engine, static_exhaust and fork_black, each _d, _n and _s; look_wear.py --rust 2026-11-23a: fewer, smaller blooms, see-through in the middle and darker at the edge, browner, fewer and fainter streaks, nothing along a badge plate's outline; 2026-11-22a's wear_rusty_static_d eccf272c2c..., wear_raider_static_d f47ab5f547...; the wear overlay's other 213 files are 2026-11-22a's bytes, so they are not listed) and the badge atlas (badges_d/_n/_s.dds: three meshing black gears either side of the 3D Brotherhood helmet, none behind it; bike_art.py --bos-ground 2026-11-23a; 2026-11-22a's e65f381ff0..., 6d226ff6c8..., 41ec97fa99...). No file is new or removed. Every mesh, material, sound and clip is 2026-11-22a's, and so are the other textures. Three compiled scripts differ, their sources having changed: CMB_ControllerScript (getting off beside you in one ask, the bike set at the checked spot, the lean from upright; getting on with no reload, a runtime-swapped parked bike hidden at once before the fade, one without a swap 0.2 s into it, stood up by its own script; the worn bike's runtime swap kept through a getting on, planned 0.1 s after its equip, retried and confirmed at its own 1.0 s, the look timer started again only while something is due, the parked bike's swap at a getting off after the ride's end), CMB_LookF4SE (the composed swap reused while it is the look as put on, a marker entry of its look in the swap, forgotten at a load) and CMB_BikeActivatorScript (StandUp: the stand-up on the bike's own thread), null accepting their bytes (their headers carry the packaged commit's time); the other nine keep their code under a new header. The commit's own files that change (CMB_Slope.dll and CMB_Slope.ini, the three .psc: _about) are not in this block.
